versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Nano Banana Pro 2 image generation and editing with Gemini 3.1 Flash via OpenRouter.
- Supports text-to-image and image-to-image creation with 0.5K, 1K, 2K, and 4K resolutions.
- Script-based workflow for both new image generation and editing existing images with descriptive prompts.
- API key can be provided via CLI or OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.
- Automatic, timestamped filename generation based on prompt content.
- Includes preflight checks, common error handling, and prompt templates for both image creation and editing.
